transcript:
So starting something new today or rather stopping something old. I
have decided to drop the morning berberine and move it just with dinner.
Doctor actually suggested this a while ago and I kept forgetting to do
this. The idea is that berberine with the evening meal might help with
overnight glucose stability better than the morning dose. We'll see. So
morning protocol today was NAC, alpha lipoic acid, creatine, Relight, no
berberine. That felt a bit weird honestly, like I was forgetting
something. I kept second guessing myself. Novothor was 15 minutes today,
actually managed the full 15. Cold shower straight after, maybe three
minutes. HRV this morning was 71, which is solid. Oh and I've added a
new thing. I'm now doing 10 minutes of outdoor light exposure right
after waking up. Before anything else, no sunglasses, just standing in
the garden. I read something about this for circadian routine
entertainment. Only day two of doing it, so too early to say anything.
Weight was 79.4 this morning. Meditation was 30 minutes. I think that's
it.

entities.label: berberine
entities.notes: moved to evening meal for better overnight glucose stability

entities.label: berberine
entities.notes: moved from morning, planned with dinner

entities.label: outdoor light exposure
entities.notes: no sunglasses, standing in garden, for circadian rhythm entrainment, day 2
